title: Stage 2 actor and memory observation foundation
purpose: Define bounded versioned actor service and buffer-copy observations before any actor-work, fairness, buffer, or backpressure policy becomes forceable.
scope: This specification covers behavior-neutral per-connection actor service and selected send-side buffer-copy observations, bounded epoch aggregation, explicit missing-state handling, schema and semantic validation, and the safety gates required before actor_work_quantum or buffer_copy_coalescing. It does not define a forceable actor policy, scalar work-unit threshold, distinct conservative buffer implementation, backpressure policy, active_internal behavior, or production activation.
context: The shard already exposes aggregate queue-delay, service-time, wake, packet-run, and follow-on metrics, but it does not expose a versioned connection-attributable evidence contract or an exactly-once repost seam. Stage 2 must preserve the current drain loop and record honest primitives before proposing a quantum.
open_questions: Which cooperative transition and effect boundaries can yield while preserving exactly-once repost, timer priority, recovery, terminal drain, and buffer ownership?
How should complete shard observation coverage and runnable intervals be proven before cross-connection fairness statistics are accepted?

requirements.title: Record bounded behavior-neutral actor service evidence
requirements.statement: The runtime MUST support disabled and observe-only actor service instrumentation that records one versioned connection-attributable observation for each observed shard dispatch with monotonic service sequence, bounded wake identity, closed work kind, queue delay, complete service duration, pending work count, effect and follow-on counts, lifecycle disposition, explicit missing and saturated state, and deterministic epoch aggregation; keep sink failures diagnostic-only; preserve the legacy_current shard drain, timer, recovery, terminal, progress, and ownership behavior; and never treat scenario, payload, requested concurrency, peer, URL, application identity, event count, pending inbox depth, or queue delay as an invented production work-unit, runnable-connection, oldest-item, or deadline-lateness signal.
notes: UsefulWorkUnitsUndefined remains explicit until a reviewed work-unit vector and cooperative safe checkpoints exist.
No actor_work_quantum value is forceable or active under this requirement.

requirements.title: Record bounded behavior-neutral buffer-copy evidence
requirements.statement: The runtime MUST support disabled and observe-only connection-local buffer-copy instrumentation that records versioned legacy_current copy, reuse, formatting, combination, and sent-plaintext-retention operations at existing ownership boundaries; reports logical bytes, copied bytes, source segments, requested and retained capacity, deterministic join scope, selected and applied identity, reason, latch, lifecycle, and explicit missing or invalid state; aggregates only fixed closed counters; keeps sink failures diagnostic-only; preserves byte identity, ordering, packet protection, recovery, congestion, pacing, flow control, hard bounds, ownership, and exactly-once release; and does not claim a distinct conservative implementation, terminal-release correlation, retained age, pool outstanding state, retransmission-clone coverage, receive-segment coverage, forcing, shadow selection, or active behavior until each is implemented and reviewed.
notes: Only legacy_current is a real buffer-copy policy value in this slice.
The observation seam cannot be used as fabricated counterfactual policy coverage.
